decisions.reason: The charting bundle builds on the map.apps platform and was released four times in a month, so active development and low upkeep make it a cheap option worth keeping open.
This low-cost plugin close to the core offer has only a mention on the website, so its uncertain value and minimal carrying cost argue for keeping the option open for now.
The mobile layer control was promoted on the home page but is a fairly experimental Vue-based component, so it stays as a cheap option while its uptake in mobile use is still unclear.
A platform for building GIS solutions underpins the firm's reusable architecture and many other options, so dropping it would destroy value even though it is only mentioned on the website.
Mobile field data capture serves established public-sector and utility customers and has its own page, so its prospects look solid and justify continued commitment.
The search extension is close to the core web-map offer, has a dedicated page and is cheap to maintain, so keeping it preserves upside at little cost.
